_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Only saying goodbye without a kind wish

segments.text: It means, be safe and stay well.
See you next week. Take care!

native.caption: ¿Siempre dices solo “Bye”? Prueba “Take care.”, que significa cuídate y suena muy natural al despedirte. Ejemplo: “See you next week. Take care!” Escucha a Ama y repite tú en la pausa. Más práctica en la app Lexkite.

en.hook: How do you say goodbye kindly?
en.caption: Do you always just say “Bye”? Try “Take care.”, which means look after yourself and sounds natural when you say goodbye. Example: “See you next week. Take care!” Listen to Ama and repeat in the pause. More practice in the Lexkite app.
